content: अभिनिवेशः .²1 .³({%a%}) Devotion, attachment, intentness, being occupied with, adherence to close application, with <ab>loc.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>; कतमस्मिंस्ते भावाभिनिवेशः <ls>V. 3</ls>; अहो निरर्थकव्यापारेष्वभिनिवेशः <ls>K. 120</ls>, <ls n="K.">146</ls>; <ls>Dk. 81</ls>; <ls>Māl. 7</ls>. .³({%b%}) Firm attachment, love, fondness, affection; बलीयान् खलु मेऽभिनिवेशः <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; अनुरूपोऽस्या ˚शः {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%}, <ls>V. 2</ls>; असत्यभूते वस्तुन्यभिनिवेशः <ls>Mit.</ls> .²2 Earnest desire, ardent longing or expectation; wish, desire; <ls>Māl. 5. 27</ls>. .²3 Resolution, determined resolve, determination of purpose, firmness of resolve, perseverance; जनकात्मजायां नितान्तरूक्षाभिनिवेशमीशम् <ls>R. 14. 43</ls>; अनुरूप˚ शतोषिणा <ls>Ku. 5. 7</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 1</ls>. .³({%b%}) Idea, thought; <ls>Ms. 12. 5</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 155</ls>. .²4 (In Yoga <ab>Phil.</ab>) A sort of ignorance causing fear of death; instinctive clinging to worldly life and bodily enjoyments and the fear that one might be cut off from all of them by death; अविद्यास्मितारागद्वेषाभिनिवेशाः पञ्चक्लेशाः <ls>Yoga S.</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also Sāṅkhya <ls>K. 150</ls> and <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Śi. 4. 55</ls>. .²5 Pride; भयं द्वितीयाभिनिवेशतः स्यात् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 2. 37</ls>.
